slot_scores.name: no_borrowing_cash_only
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never explicitly asked whether borrowing is allowed or whether investments must be funded only by currently available cash. The closest cash-related question concerned only whether product (1) has a total capital cap, not the no-borrowing/cash-only constraint.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: At the start of each year, investments cannot exceed the cash available at that time, and no borrowing is allowed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not ask whether borrowing was permitted, but later included cash-only budget constraints in its READY_TO_MODEL summary as if confirmed.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot about borrowing/cash-only funding remained unresolved and was silently assumed.

summary: The agent asked many detailed questions about returns, caps, simultaneity, and transaction costs, but failed to clarify whether borrowing is allowed or whether only available cash can be invested. It then silently assumed cash-only funding in its READY_TO_MODEL summary, leaving a P1 hidden slot unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
